programme.title: 金玉满堂 / Happy Ever After
programme.desc: 东官(欧阳震华)天生一条「皇帝 利」擅尝天下美食，小小(陈妙瑛)擅煮麻辣，为替父报仇，不惜出卖东官，令他背上欺君之名，被迫由广州逃至京城。当小小得悉东官是无辜，遂负荆请罪，二人终冰释前嫌，且情愫渐生。而二人合力炮制的「夫妻肺片」更获乾隆(江华)赏识，东官因此被选入御膳房，从此平步青云，成为皇帝身边的红人。东官好友勉良(郭晋安)得贤妻翠花(梁艺龄)苦心扶持，终考得功名。但后竟「弃糟糠」与昔日爱人倩容(张慧仪)重拾旧欢，难得翠花仍为顾全他声名而哑忍。岂料，倩容竟暗中替他收受贿款，令他仕途尽毁...另一方面，乾隆一次酒醉，令东官红颜心茹(陈松伶)龙胎暗结，但因太后下令「汉不点妃」，乾隆唯有迫东官迎娶之。小小不知就里，竟告上公堂，更掀起满汉之争！.

programme.title: 楼奴 / Brick Slaves
programme.desc: 楼耀明(王浩信)动用与女朋友多年的积蓄置业结婚，谁料女友提出分手，又私自将单位租给钢琴教师蔡坚菁(李施嬅)，刚失恋的耀明好景不常又遭公司裁员，为了供楼无奈接受坚菁提出苛刻的条件，二人因生活习惯不同常起争端，但耀明察觉坚菁使人退避三舍的背后原来埋藏着一段往事。耀明终在物业管理公司找到新工作，耀明的空降破坏了三代楼奴劳必达(麦长青)的升职梦，必达为保饭碗与耀明水火不容，但耀明却得老板利爱华(商天娥)赏识，更着他特别照顾实习生祝碧姬(岑丽香)，二人因工作关系见尽楼奴百态，碧姬对耀明渐生爱意，但耀明深知自己所爱是谁，此时坚菁突然要求中断租约…….

programme.title: 大步走 / The Runner
programme.desc: 网媒编辑何家欣(姚子羚饰)奉命接近「竞风田径社」挖掘丑闻，与跑步教练袁力(陈山聪饰)结识。袁力因过去的憾事，避免和人建立关系，但他屡与家欣交集，渐走渐近。富商郭皇普(蒋志光饰)之女郭贝儿(刘颖旋饰)怀着特殊目的，主动加入竞风社；皇普却成了竞风社的赞助人，与袁力不断角力。袁力受好友黎舜梵(张达伦饰)所托，照顾年少的儿子麦宇笙，二人逐步培养出师徒情谊，而舜梵与家欣原来曾有感情纠葛。舜梵及后因顽疾自暴自弃，袁力决意令他振作，同时亦审视自身，要重新踏上跑道…….

programme.title: 巾帼枭雄 / Rosy Business
programme.desc: 一场天灾，粉碎了本是小家碧玉康宝琦(邓萃雯)与无锡米王蒋乔(岳华)的婚约；一次断粮，灭绝了她全家的性命而沦落为朝廷钦犯。多年来，在宝琦的内心只惦念着当年弃约的蒋乔，总在设法亲自求证自己所爱之人绝非无情之士，直至一次偶然的机会，宝琦与蒋乔再遇，得以再续前缘，顺利嫁入蒋家成了四姨太。自入门后，宝琦常遭大奶奶殷凤仪(谢雪心)及二少奶彭娇(商天娥)的无理加害，但她心思慎密、不拘小节，眼观全局，总是化危为机。乔深明大义，心里由衷敬佩宝琦的识见及坚持，当他病危离世前决将米业交由她托管，希望她找出最适当的接任人。这个千斤重任令宝琦腹背受敌，但她不负所托，竭力掌管家业及细心寻觅接任人，终让她发现外表只管吃喝玩乐的二子蒋必正 (吴卓羲)原是为人正直、重情重义之士，且在米行内极具亲和力，宝琦便一面扶植必正上位，一面力挡当年在蒋家受尽折磨，存心报仇的柴九(黎耀祥)。柴九事事冲着蒋家而来，处处对蒋家不利，二人斗智

programme.title: 守业者 / Storm In A Cocoon
programme.desc: 「永泰隆」乃民初广东的丝绸王国，大老板潘永年(岳华)年事已高，把业务交由长子潘家显(麦长青)及二女潘巧儿(康华)打理，不料巧儿离奇自杀，在外当军医的三子潘家扬(马浚伟)重回家乡接掌大权，却发现巧儿之死疑点重重，巧儿生前好友丝厂女工唐冰冰(杨怡)同感满腹疑团，两人决意展开追查，却揭发家族与丝厂各人关系错综复杂，每个人都有杀人嫌疑，令家扬里外受敌。而在丝厂打工的自梳女皆以女工头冼碧云(邵美琪)为大家姐，却处处与冰冰为敌，大话妹冯芷晴(唐诗咏)加入工厂后，甘愿自梳，竟又另有目的，以致引狼入室。而冰冰仗义勇敢的作风深深吸引了家扬，两人情愫渐生之际，冰冰失多年的未婚夫关祖耀(曹永廉)突然回乡，引起轩然巨波，血染桑田。而杀害巧儿的凶手更是出人意表，潘家家业，因果报应，作茧自缚。家扬与冰冰，决心坚守家业，却要面对整个家族纠缠不清，千丝万缕的境况…….

programme.desc: 楼耀明(王浩信)动用与女朋友多年的积蓄置业结婚，谁料女友提出分手，又私自将单位租给钢琴教师蔡坚菁(李施嬅)，刚失恋的耀明好景不常又遭公司裁员，为了供楼无奈接受坚菁提出苛刻的条件，二人因生活习惯不同常起争端，但耀明察觉坚菁使人退避三舍的背后原来埋藏着一段往事。耀明终在物业管理公司找到新工作，耀明的空降破坏了三代楼奴劳必达(麦长青)的升职梦，必达为保饭碗与耀明水火不容，但耀明却得老板利爱华(商天娥)赏识，更着他特别照顾实习生祝碧姬(岑丽香)，二人因工作关系见尽楼奴百态，碧姬对耀明渐生爱意，但耀明深知自己所爱是谁，此时坚菁突然要求中断租约…….

programme.title: 大步走 / The Runner
programme.desc: 网媒编辑何家欣(姚子羚饰)奉命接近「竞风田径社」挖掘丑闻，与跑步教练袁力(陈山聪饰)结识。袁力因过去的憾事，避免和人建立关系，但他屡与家欣交集，渐走渐近。富商郭皇普(蒋志光饰)之女郭贝儿(刘颖旋饰)怀着特殊目的，主动加入竞风社；皇普却成了竞风社的赞助人，与袁力不断角力。袁力受好友黎舜梵(张达伦饰)所托，照顾年少的儿子麦宇笙，二人逐步培养出师徒情谊，而舜梵与家欣原来曾有感情纠葛。舜梵及后因顽疾自暴自弃，袁力决意令他振作，同时亦审视自身，要重新踏上跑道…….

programme.title: 巾帼枭雄 / Rosy Business
programme.desc: 一场天灾，粉碎了本是小家碧玉康宝琦(邓萃雯)与无锡米王蒋乔(岳华)的婚约；一次断粮，灭绝了她全家的性命而沦落为朝廷钦犯。多年来，在宝琦的内心只惦念着当年弃约的蒋乔，总在设法亲自求证自己所爱之人绝非无情之士，直至一次偶然的机会，宝琦与蒋乔再遇，得以再续前缘，顺利嫁入蒋家成了四姨太。自入门后，宝琦常遭大奶奶殷凤仪(谢雪心)及二少奶彭娇(商天娥)的无理加害，但她心思慎密、不拘小节，眼观全局，总是化危为机。乔深明大义，心里由衷敬佩宝琦的识见及坚持，当他病危离世前决将米业交由她托管，希望她找出最适当的接任人。这个千斤重任令宝琦腹背受敌，但她不负所托，竭力掌管家业及细心寻觅接任人，终让她发现外表只管吃喝玩乐的二子蒋必正 (吴卓羲)原是为人正直、重情重义之士，且在米行内极具亲和力，宝琦便一面扶植必正上位，一面力挡当年在蒋家受尽折磨，存心报仇的柴九(黎耀祥)。柴九事事冲着蒋家而来，处处对蒋家不利，二人斗智

programme.title: 守业者 / Storm In A Cocoon
programme.desc: 「永泰隆」乃民初广东的丝绸王国，大老板潘永年(岳华)年事已高，把业务交由长子潘家显(麦长青)及二女潘巧儿(康华)打理，不料巧儿离奇自杀，在外当军医的三子潘家扬(马浚伟)重回家乡接掌大权，却发现巧儿之死疑点重重，巧儿生前好友丝厂女工唐冰冰(杨怡)同感满腹疑团，两人决意展开追查，却揭发家族与丝厂各人关系错综复杂，每个人都有杀人嫌疑，令家扬里外受敌。而在丝厂打工的自梳女皆以女工头冼碧云(邵美琪)为大家姐，却处处与冰冰为敌，大话妹冯芷晴(唐诗咏)加入工厂后，甘愿自梳，竟又另有目的，以致引狼入室。而冰冰仗义勇敢的作风深深吸引了家扬，两人情愫渐生之际，冰冰失多年的未婚夫关祖耀(曹永廉)突然回乡，引起轩然巨波，血染桑田。而杀害巧儿的凶手更是出人意表，潘家家业，因果报应，作茧自缚。家扬与冰冰，决心坚守家业，却要面对整个家族纠缠不清，千丝万缕的境况…….

programme.title: 守业者 / Storm In A Cocoon

programme.title: 银楼金粉 / Silver Chamber Of Sorrows, The
programme.desc: 广东佛山第一大银楼『尚银楼』面临生意危机，大老爷尚铿(秦沛)为取得沈家借贷，不惜与正室赛小蝶(薛家燕)施计强逼二少爷尚鋆(伍卫国)与沈家千金沈咏彤(杨婉仪)成亲，令鋆的意中人程秀杏(伍咏薇)一怒之下嫁入尚家做三姨太。鋆从此与铿反目成仇，远渡重洋，兄弟不相往还。直至老太爷大寿那天，鋆始肯回家，但小儿子突遭绑架，铿不愿交出赎金，令兄弟再起冲突，鋆决意分家。另方面，自鋆回来后，一直被铿冷落的杏面对着二叔深感痛苦，又被诬告害至四姨太霏霏(胡定欣)小产，杏痛定思痛向尚家进行报复，利用鋆之余情，暗中撩弄尚家上下，又揭发近身丫环秋菊(杨思琦)原是铿与有夫之妇留下的孽种，连串打击令一代豪门声名狼藉，万劫不复......

programme.title: 香港爱情故事 / Hong Kong Love Stories
programme.desc: 暖男设计师陈子朗(罗天宇饰)与理想主义女友邱凯琪(龚嘉欣饰)，是香港典型因土地问题而被迫流离浪荡的情侣。子朗两位妹妹陈子欣(王敏奕饰)和陈子婷(游嘉欣饰)性格极端，摄影师子欣沉沦于艺术家纪家希(谢东闵饰)的失乐园；品学兼优的大学女神子婷，爱之初体验以现实先行，两姊妹各有恋事。子朗、凯琪为觅安乐窝打拼，新婚后居于百多呎的劏房，除了要面对空间不足的生活磨擦外，还要处理双方父母的暮年感情危机！小两口排除万难，置业美梦却一夜变噩梦，为了一层楼竟忘记如何好好恋爱…….

programme.title: Click入黄金屋 / Pages Of Treasures
programme.desc: 『知识就是力量』，一直是书店职员方学文(秦沛)坚信的道理，所以他总设法让大儿子方心明(黎耀祥)和小儿子方心正(孙耀威)体会个中学问，可惜明书缘薄，中学毕业后已投身社会，反之正天资聪慧是读书好材料，明不惜远道重洋工作，供养弟弟到美国修读计算机课程。两兄弟因工作关系回流香港，两人在同一商厦工作，不过正任职高级网络保安工程师，而明则是大厦的初级保安员，文深知二人身份差异将有碍兄弟感情，加上眼见明心仪纸黏土模型店的店主袁慧中(郭羡妮)，文即筹谋接手经营一家旧书店，为明前途作打算。可惜令知书达礼的文最忧心的却是，一个他无法掌控的虚拟力量正步步蚕食他的家庭，就如正在工作上认识了追寻浪漫爱情的同行徐希敏(杨秀惠)，因而与女友雷婉仪(杨思琦)发生误会；小女儿方心美(何傲儿)因沉迷上网，被怀疑于网上偷取试卷而掀起连串风波…….

programme.title: Click入黄金屋 / Pages Of Treasures

programme.desc: 济公为一煲莲子羹错杀哮天犬，罪咎难容，惨遭贬落凡间受苦以作磨练，并要积众功德以助一同沦落凡间的哮天犬及玉女重返天庭。济公与哮天犬被安排降生成兄弟，济化身成蠢钝污秽的修缘(梁荣忠)，饱受冷眼；而犬则变为俊朗聪明的释缘(何宝生)，集万千宠爱在一身；原貌美可人的玉女无奈变成丑八怪纪柔(梁小冰)。一次阴差阳错，修缘重得智慧及法力，众人对他亦渐改观。修缘得以重张旗鼓，对释缘开始诸多留难，更与他竞逐纪柔的感情。最后，柔选择了修缘，拒料成亲当日竟命殒当场…….

programme.title: 兄弟帮 / Big Boys Club
programme.desc: 《兄弟帮》是由一班「好兄弟」林盛斌、梁竞徽、王梓轩、范振锋及陈国峰主持的年青人清谈节目，每集邀请歌手、艺人或不同界别人士作嘉宾，进行轻松访谈，带来时下社会热话、流行文化、潮流玩意等多元化内容。有关爱情、两性，以致同性关系，是男男女女谈之不尽的话题，节目邀来不同界别的嘉宾「谈情说爱」，探讨两性相处之道。「异度空间」专题，请来嘉宾分享不思议事件，如见鬼、UFO、奇人奇事等刺激话题。.

programme.title: 我家无难事 / Kwoks And What, The
programme.desc: 第五集\n忠石自称跟美兰关系密切，郭家众人对其身份存疑。致澄找当警察的兄长庄致远帮忙，查出忠石原是黑道中人……得勤对羽菲仍未忘情往找她，羽菲却不值得勤所为，拒绝和好。二人及后忆起相恋经过，倍感唏嘘。忠石重遇前同门麦源，发现社团和顺兴已经没落。得宝母子惊觉忠石有郭家锁匙，更持有美兰跟他立下的借据。忠石强行进驻郭家，得勤、得明亦决定搬回老家……郭家众人受致远启发，决定寻找忠石的犯罪证据，忠石悄悄举枪…….

programme.title: 卧底娇娃 & 今日知多D / Pretty Dangerous & What's On Today
programme.desc: 毒品「粉精灵」流窜市面，警方卧底潘奕风(马贯东饰)潜伏多年，终将制毒师权世豪绳之于法，但后者只被轻判！奕风向上级提出继续卧底计划，还获允许组建卧底女团，追查世豪背后的神秘上线。奕风找来三名各有所长的卧底娇娃— 「女版福尔摩斯」沈佳琪(张曦雯饰)、「细心敏锐武术通」江妙姿(陈滢饰)，以及「百变行走数据库」童小茹(罗毓仪饰)。她们要接近慈善商人刘彪(关礼杰饰)和卡邦妮(邵美琪饰)夫妇，而唯一缺口是两人的女儿刘宝仪(钟柔美饰)。然而，奕风推动女卧底们执行连串惊险任务，却是暗藏目的…….

programme.title: 爱．回家之开心速递 / Lo And Behold
programme.desc: 熊树根(刘丹)由基层做起，他时常牵挂的只有三位宝贝女儿，大女早已移民海外、二女熊若水(吕慧仪)已届适婚年龄却嫁杏无期，经常与优异生妹妹熊心如(苏韵姿)为琐碎事争吵不休，令老爸哭笑不得。.

programme.title: 东张西望 / Scoop 2026
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报导娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。.

programme.title: 最强生命线 / Vital Lifeline
programme.desc: 都市人生活节奏紧张，压力又大，身体易出毛病，《最强生命线》为你解构健康之道。首先一连四集介绍都市痛症系列，分别是头痛，肩颈痛，背痛，关节痛。每集都会邀请医学专家讲解各种疾病的成因，还有物理治疗师，运动治疗师教做适当的运动。现在流行中西医结合，美国游泳健将菲比斯都用拔罐来纾缓疼痛，所以每集都会有中医断症，辅以针灸，拔罐和三伏天最适合做的天灸等治疗方法，另外，中医还教我们煲滋补的汤水，都可以调理身体。.

programme.title: 星河长明 / Shining Just for You
programme.desc: 第14集\n七海伶和界诸婴为了躲避左近天的追杀，选择带领族人穿越危险的夜沼前往越州。在途中，他们遇到了困难，但最终通过与土伯的交易成功穿越。然而，到达营地时发现夜北族人被左近天抓走，七海伶和界诸婴为救族人分别被擒。另一方面，叶凌霜因与翼无忧私下见面被樊如晦设计陷害，被彧修明关入天牢，后因其能缓解彧修明的头痛被冷天曦放出。.

programme.title: 流行都市 / Big City Shop 2026
programme.desc: 《流行都市》为观众介绍时令产品、健康养生、健体运动、护肤化妆、时尚服饰、婴幼儿护理、育儿知识、城中美食、饲养宠物等潮流信息，内容包罗万有！主持们亲身体验、示范或测试之外，还会邀请嘉宾带来相关专业知识。烹饪环节方面，多位手势了得的厨艺专家轮流登场，示范简单美味的健康美食、家常小菜，替大家解决煮食烦恼。.

programme.title: 快乐长门人 / Happy Old Buddies
programme.desc: 不少人或会认为长者并没有性需要，但有调查发现结果却非如此，长者只是因为不同原因引致性生活有所减少。社署临床心理学家林晧明详述世卫对性的定义，并替想跟老伴重启性生活的老友记带来建议。不过，另一半如不想恢复性行为，双方应如何沟通？.

programme.title: 我们家的料理 / The Taste Of Us
programme.desc: 色香味全的佳肴，不仅填饱肚子，更可慰藉心灵！酷爱唱歌与美食的自由工作者亮亮(冯皓扬饰)，因与女友Jessica(倪嘉雯饰)分手若有所失，为了证明自己的经济能力，遂把空出的房间出租。租客阿治(顾定轩饰)热爱烹饪，不时发挥「煮意」，炮制出「味噌大蚬汤」、「鸡肉牛油果墨西哥卷」等层出不穷的暖心料理……两个大男孩一拍即合，「医肚」的同时，互相「填补」彼此的空虚！个性截然不同的两个人，会建立怎样的有趣关系？.

programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报导娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。.

programme.title: 香港早晨 / Good Morning Hong Kong
programme.desc: 报导香港、两岸及国际重要新闻。.

programme.title: 我家无难事 / Kwoks And What, The
programme.desc: 第六集\n得勤欲赶走忠石，但得宝等人却同意暂时收留他。忠石向法庭申请重新分配郭家单位的业权，得勤决定聘请律师与忠石对簿公堂。得明让出工作室给耀山暂住，自己则搬回郭家。各人因生活习惯各异，不断争拗……羽菲筹备拍摄咖啡广告，得勤竟前来面试代言人……得勤借题发挥与得宝针锋相对，怀疑忠石跟美兰之间的关系，忠石道出美兰珍藏的风水石来历。得勤自我反省，希望可以重获弟妹的信任。另一边厢，忠石忆起与美兰相识的经过…….

programme.title: 港生活．港享受 / Dolce Vita 2021
programme.desc: 香港人生活多姿多采，《港生活．港享受》既呈献高贵典雅的品味生活，也会带来贴地亲民的优质享受。节目结合多元化主题，每集探索不同范畴，并请来各行各业的精英分享成功之道。.

programme.title: Hands Up / Hands Up 2026
programme.desc:
全新儿童节目《Hands Up》鼓励小朋友勇于发问，表达自我，向目标进发！

吉祥物「酱汁家族」成员跟一众主持演出短剧，陪伴大家度过愉快时光。另会带来多首儿歌，让孩子们边唱边学习生活知识。

小朋友走进录像厂，寓学习于娱乐。透过不同主题游戏，加强逻辑思维、锻练体能；玩转STEAM实验，脑力全开！

节目特设表演小舞台，让小朋友展示才艺；齐集创意工作室，DIY小手工。小教「煮」环节，家长和子女共享亲子烹饪乐趣。.

programme.title: 踩过界 II / Legal Mavericks 2020
programme.desc:
第十三集

申侠独自步入树林，准备自杀。美娜赶来，成功劝阻，二人相拥痛哭。正妹、一夏赶至见状，大受打击，二人买醉，拥吻入睡过了一夜，醒来后却怕被人知道发生关系，唯有保守秘密。申侠申请让Zaw视像作供，一夏亦劝服福全不要认罪。Zaw在庭上指出凶案现场有第三者，但看不见样子，被镇岳成功反驳。休庭后，建锋亦开始怀疑福全，宇轩怒不可遏，与建锋起争执。申侠在庭上追问福全凶案现场的第三者是谁，福全一时气愤昏倒……
.

programme.title: 踩过界 II / Legal Mavericks 2020
programme.desc: 第十四集\n\n一凡代表商界拉拢绍宏，只要绍宏当选大律师公会主席，就会出钱兴建法律学院。申侠故意要令福全住院，以争取时间找出凶案现场的第三者，一夏认定宇轩嫌疑最大。美娜反对绍宏参选，绍宏坚称不会受到商家摆布。宇轩探望福全，宝钗帮一夏欺骗宇轩，讹称福全患有绝症。绍宏拉拢申侠当自己的竞选拍档，被申侠拒绝，绍宏却对外宣称获申侠支持。宇轩答应出庭作证，但途中遇上交通意外……福全心灰意冷，放弃抗辩，众人苦劝不果。.

programme.title: 东张西望 / Scoop 2026
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报导娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。.

programme.title: 还原神之食 / Food Mister
programme.desc:
第9集
苹果炖饭、全素早晨拉面
日漫《食戟之灵》曾出现父子美食对决的场面，最终「全素早晨拉面」压倒「苹果炖饭」。泳芍这次尝试还原后者，却极有信心「逆转胜」由欣茵煮理的拉面，因为欣茵连当中的主要食材「天贝」亦不知为何物！

欣茵唯有向手造天贝达人详细了解这种来自印度尼西亚、营养价值极高的超级食物；泳芍则认真为五款苹果试味，务求挑选最合适的果材。但二人于实际比拼期间错漏不少，积奇会判哪位胜出？

积奇亦试试以天贝入馔，简易做出素食「天贝烤蔬菜」。.

programme.title: 大梦想家 / Big Big Home
programme.desc: 新楼华丽时尚，可省却不少装潢烦恼。旧屋只要多花心思，也可换上耳目一新的感觉。主持谭凯萤游走台湾各地，深入市区黄金地段、新市镇发展潜力区域，探寻气派不凡的豪宅别墅与特色家居，细看《大梦想家》！移居台湾的港人，如何实现置业与创业梦想？多位「梦想家」分享当地的买楼故事与生活指南。导演赖丰奇、台裔美籍歌手荣忠豪、艺人杨子黎、音乐制作人陈宏佳、来自加拿大的「中文计算机之父」刘力学等，也会在节目中公开安乐窝。.

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷 / ChatSAT
programme.desc: 会用尽所能搜罗世界各地至潮、至新情报，上至世界盛事、医学百科、文艺与科技；下至日常生活、网络热搜，在每个星期六跟观众一一分享。论尽天南地北，畅谈人气热话，「谷友」紧贴节目，便可轻松掌握全球脉搏动向。.

programme.title: 中年好声音4 / Midlife, Sing & Shine! 4
programme.desc: 《中年好聲音4》宣佈啟航，延續前三季的成功，再次為歌唱愛好者築建逐夢舞台。本季更將招募版圖擴展至北美、澳洲等地，還有TVB多位藝員「蒙面」出戰，讓音樂之火燃遍全球，照亮無數追夢者的心弦。車婉婉繼續主持大局，以溫暖笑容陪伴一眾選手；肥媽、周國豐、張佳添、海兒、谷婭溦亦坐鎮評審席，為參賽者提供專業點評與鼓勵。在新一季的舞台上，大家將以音樂交織出更動人的篇章，續寫屬於《中年好聲音》的真摰故事。.

programme.title: 一周星星 / Star Weekly
programme.desc: 访谈节目《一周星星》，每集邀请星级艺人、界别名人，与区永权、许文轩、王镇泉等娱乐主播，分享新近工作企划，谈论电影、电视、演唱会相关的特别话题，尤其是网民与圈中朋友关心热议的人和事！周边讯息如此多，节目特设「Fact Check」核实环节，由嘉宾亲自回应各式各样的传闻，让当事人说清楚个中真相！.

programme.title: 不可能任务 / Profession Impossible
programme.desc:
第6集
特警遴选体验— 基本体能训练
新一轮《不可能任务》启动，谭俊彦率领李思雅、伍富桥、何泳芍、关曜儁、吴紫韵、余应彤、邬嘉骏，参与警察特别部队联合基本遴选。

来回跑共设三个阶段，思雅跑到面青口唇白；俊彦、曜儁互相支持，坚持到最后！考生需要左右手各持十五磅哑铃，配合不同动作举起三百次，无奈三位女生始终力量不足。

接连挑战掌上压、仰卧起坐，未达目标嘉骏被考官要求离场，他竟拒绝？接受拳击训练前，俊彦为队友们作简单指导，还与曜儁预演对打环节。.

programme.title: 恩雨之声 / Showers of Blessing
美食新闻报道 / Gourmet Express
programme.desc: 香港汇聚环球美食，特色佳肴、贴地料理受到识饮识食之人的密切关注！黄婉曼、蔡雪莹、倪嘉雯、黄嘉雯、廖慧仪、伍倩彤等美食主播、主持，紧贴最新饮食情报与优惠，深入了解滋味背后的故事。从不同平台网罗超人气食店的情报，主持亲自出动排队、试食，带来真实食评。不设堂食的外卖小店亦深受追捧，有何必吃之选？经营食店难免尝尽甜酸苦辣，摄制队追踪主理人忙碌的一天，从搜购食材、准备材料到开档做生意，揭开「故事味缘」。.

programme.title: 六点半新闻报导 / News At 18:30
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六点半，报导本地、两岸及国际重要新闻。.

programme.title: 新闻透视 & 被出轨的人 / News Magazine 2026 & Trick Or Cheat
programme.desc: 《新闻透视》，每周专题报导多段香港以至国际的瞩目新闻，聚焦港人最关心的民生话题，并邀请各界人士、学者、专家，一同深入探讨个中来龙去脉。.

programme.title: 东张西望 / Scoop 2026
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报导娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。.

programme.title: 香港系列之细间始终你好 / Hong Kong: Never Too Small
programme.desc: 在时代浪潮的冲刷下，描绘着城市缩影的本地小店越来越少，它们却是建构城市的重要部份，也是无可取替的香港精神。有见及此，「贴地」主持人阮兆祥引领观众一店一探秘，到访衣、食、住、行四大民生领域的老字号、新派小店，带出店铺的经营历史、守业辛酸，娓娓道来几代人背后的故事，以有形小店留下无形回忆，呈现「细间」始终美好！.

programme.title: 唱钱 / Music Money Monster
programme.desc: 挑战音域的极限、拍子的精准，全新互动音乐游戏节目《唱钱》由森美、Eric Kwok、李茵彤任主持，以专业音准分析系统考验参赛者。九宫格代表九个难度等级，参赛者每当连成一线「过三关」，可选择提款离场、继续挑战，甚至是最难的Monster关卡。一旦过关失败，奖金即归零！素人版独自闯关，力争最高十万元奖金。明星版为观众谋福利，而观众参与直播间互动，狂揿Emoji为参赛歌手打气，同时有机会赢取奖金、礼品。.

programme.title: J Music / J Music 2026
programme.desc: 《J Music》致力打造高质音乐平台，一众歌手有展示音乐实力的机会之余，也可让乐迷更深入了解歌手的音乐故事。节目邀请「人气」歌手担任嘉宾，由嘉宾亲自挑选其喜欢的新旧作品，并即场演唱，分享喜爱曲目。而一些乐坛新面孔亦会亮相，透过互动交流，展现音乐潜力。此外，每集紧贴「劲歌金榜」最新形势，送上歌曲MV外，还会带来不同歌手、创作人或制作人的访问，跟观众畅谈作品，以至音乐业界的人和事。.

programme.title: 直播灵接触 / You Are Not Alone Again
programme.desc: 《直播灵接触》载誉归来，第二季继续由「鬼王」梁思浩带领主持拍档黄耀英、黄紫恩，以及小编黄滢仴、汤之欣，为观众带来更多惊吓与惊喜。每集锁定不同灵异主题，诚邀「重量级」嘉宾讲鬼故，揭开法科风俗与行业秘闻。世界之大无奇不有，节目网罗各地「阴讯」，紫恩还会前赴韩国与台湾，一探当地异闻。跟观众实时互动亦是「灵接触」亮点，团队紧贴直播.

programme.title: 晚间新闻 / News Roundup
programme.desc: 报导香港、两岸、国际重要新闻以及体育消息，让你洞悉各地大事及体坛动向.

programme.title: Happy Parky
programme.desc: Tim and Kai try to give Parky the best day ever.

programme.title: Storm
programme.desc: When a storm keeps the Rexes at home they must think of a game to pass the time.

programme.title: Bat and Ball
programme.desc: Madame Gazelle teaches the children how to play Bat and Ball. She teaches them so well that they win the game!

programme.title: Buried Treasure
programme.desc: Peppa, George, Molly Mole and Freddy Fox dig a huge tunnel and find a box of pirate treasure. The treasure has gone missing - something mysterious is going on!

programme.title: Valentine's Day
programme.desc: It is Valentine's Day and Daddy Pig gives Mummy Pig a card but Where's Daddy Pig's card from Mummy? Mummy Pig had put it in the post, but it hasn't arrived yet. Will Daddy Pig get a card?

programme.title: The Perfect Day
programme.desc: Peppa and her family visit a big shop full of little shops! Mummy is visiting the spa for a 'Perfect Day Experience', so Peppa, George and Daddy Pig explore the shopping centre in search of their own perfect days!

programme.title: The Flying Vet
programme.desc: Doctor Hamster is rushed off her feet when nearly all the animals need her help on the same day.

programme.title: Kylie Kangeroo
programme.desc: Peppa and George meet Kylie Kangaroo and her brother Joey. Peppa shows Kylie how to jump up and down in muddy puddles, but who can jump the highest?

programme.title: Captain Daddy Dog
programme.desc: Mummy Dog and Danny are very excited! Captain Daddy Dog is home from the sea, and he's bearing gifts! What can they be?

programme.title: Grampy Rabbit's Dinosaur Park
programme.desc: To celebrate Freddy Fox's birthday, the children go on a trip to a Dinosaur Park. With Grampy Rabbit as their leader, they follow dinosaur footprints to find Freddy's birthday treat.

programme.title: Bedtime Story
programme.desc: Daddy Pig reads Peppa and George a bedtime story. Later George wakes up again, so Peppa has to make up another story.

programme.title: Private Club / Green Algae
programme.desc: Barbabeau, Barbabelle, and Barbabright have built a treehouse. // Barbamama is determined to stop a foul pollution.

programme.title: The Invasion / Prank Day
programme.desc: Barbalala receives a package and discovers little pink animals inside, which she calls the SQUEAKIES. // Barbabravo, Barbalala and Barbabeau are fed up with their brothers and sisters laughing at their expense.

programme.title: The Sharkdog Scoop
programme.desc: When Mom is assigned to investigate Sharkdog's wild side for the news, she realizes there's nothing scary about Max's best friend.

programme.title: The Party Animal
programme.desc: When Sharkdog accidentally destroys the boardwalk, Max and Sharkpack must prove to everyone that Sharkdog is a really great pet.

programme.title: Working Like a Sharkdog
programme.desc: All Sharkdog wants to do is play with his new toy, but when Dad ends up on a wild adventure through town, Sharkdog must give up his playtime and come to Dad's rescue.

programme.title: The Great Bedtime Race
programme.desc: It's nighttime in Axle City, and Blaze and AJ stumble upon the race of their dreams: the Great Bedtime Race! But Crusher is also in the race and he won't rest until he wins. Will Blaze come out on top, or will Crusher take home the Nightlight Trophy?

programme.title: Sea Turtle Submarine
programme.desc: Blaze and AJ are at the beach when they meet an adorable new friend: Shelly the sea turtle! But when Shelly can't find her way home to the Seaweed Forest, Blaze turns into a Sea Turtle Submarine to help lead the way!

programme.title: The Crew Builds A Big Bike Shop / The Crew Builds A Super Tub
programme.desc: Rubble and the pups work to build a big bike shop in time for the Bike Festival... unless Speed Meister beats them to it! // When Motor won't take a bath before their family photo, it's up to Rubble and the pups to find a construction solution.

programme.title: The Crew Builds An Ice Cream Shop / The Crew Fixes A Squeak
programme.desc: When a windy day derails construction on an ice cream shop, Rubble, Mix, Wheeler, and Charger are on the chase. // There's a mysterious squeak in City Hall. Mayor Greatway asks Rubble and Charger to find and fix the squeak before her big speech!

programme.title: Pups Save the Bunnies / Puptacular
programme.desc: Farmer Yumi's carrots are disappearing and she calls Ryder and the Paw Patrol for help. // Katie is excited to be entering one of the Paw Patrol pups into a puppy grooming competition "Puptacular" in the next town.

programme.title: Pups Save the Bay / Pups Save a Goodway
programme.desc: Ryder and the PAW Patrol clean up a small oil spill in the water to save the animals in Adventure Bay. // When Adventure Bay's famous statue ends up at the bottom of the Bay, Ryder and the PAW Patrol have to find a clever way to bring it back!

programme.title: Double Dare You / Roy
programme.desc: On a ski trip, the Barbapapas build a giant igloo. Barbabravo and Barbalib challenge each other to find out who is braver. // Barbabright creates a vacuuming robot that's also very good at soccer. The Barbababies organise a match against the robots.

programme.title: The Grass is Always Greener... / When I Grow Up
programme.desc: Barbabright coats the house in magic product to prevent water leakage. The next day, The house deflates like a balloon. // A bird builds its nest on Barbazoo's belly. Barbazoo wants to become a big tree to shelter animals. This becomes complicated.

programme.title: Rocket Race / Magic / Parents
programme.desc: Tommy is in a Rocket Race, Tim supports his brother. // Tim distracts Tia when Tusky is in the washing machine. // The kids become the parents and the parents become the kids.

programme.title: Boots / Moon Parrot / Tailball
programme.desc: Tim tries out some new rocket boots which soon fly out of control. // Tim, Tommy and Tia bird-sit the Bronte's MoonParrot. // Tim, Tommy and Tia take on their parents at Tailball.

programme.title: Abuela's Quinceanera / Story Time
programme.desc: Dora finds out that her Abuela never had a quinceańera and throws her a super-secret surprise party with a special dress, tiara, and shoes! // Dora's friend Coco doesn't have a story for Story Time, so they go to the Tall Tale Tree in search of one!

programme.title: Run Cynthia Run / Dora In Space
programme.desc: Dora and Boots get help from Carmelo the Condor to fix their friend's running shoes in time for the rainforest race! // Dora and Boots rescue Tico from space after his spaceship falls apart!

programme.title: Mr Bull the Teacher
programme.desc: Madame Gazelle must go to the dentist so leaves the class with Mr Bull. The children already know the subjects Mr Bull suggests teaching, so he decides to show them how to fix a squeaky floorboard.

programme.title: Looking for Things
programme.desc: Mummy Pig is baking an apple pie, so Daddy Pig suggests Peppa and George play a game of looking for things. Peppa and George have fun running around the house solving the clues.

programme.title: Poems
programme.desc: Madame Gazelle introduces the children to poetry, explaining how sounds can be poems too. Together they make a poem about rain and perform it to the parents.

programme.title: Please and Thank You
programme.desc: Granny and Grandpa talk to Peppa and George about manners. Madame Gazelle teaches all the children about how wonderful it is to say please and thank you.

programme.title: Ice Cream
programme.desc: Mr Labrador has an ice cream van but runs out of ice cream. Granny Pig suggests Peppa and George make their own ice cream with the help of Mr Labrador.

programme.title: Science Museum
programme.desc: Peppa and her friends go on a school trip to visit a science museum. There are lots of fun activities including bubbly water, static balloons and Grampy Rabbit's rocket ship.

programme.title: The Great Bedtime Race
programme.desc: It's nighttime in Axle City, and Blaze and AJ stumble upon the race of their dreams: the Great Bedtime Race! But Crusher is also in the race and he won't rest until he wins. Will Blaze come out on top, or will Crusher take home the Nightlight Trophy?

programme.title: Pups Save a Floundering Francois / Pups Save the Pop-Up Penguins
programme.desc: Cap'n Turbot and his cousin Francois are whale watching when the Flounder hits a rock and starts to sink! This rescue needs all paws on deck. // Stowaway penguins have scattered around Adventure Bay! Time to call the PAW Patrol!

programme.desc: Mayor Humdinger makes fake emergencies for his kitties to save so they appear better then the PAW Patrol.

programme.title: Where? There!
programme.desc: Laa-Laa and Po play a game of 'hide and seek'. They both take turns at hiding. Tinky Winky and Dispsy are hiding too and Laa-Laa and Po find them together.

programme.title: Monkey
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say 'monkey' and we go on a whirlwind word adventure! We see lots of monkeys - a furry monkey, a swinging monkey, a jumping monkey and a funky monkey!

programme.title: Itchy
programme.desc: Farmer Fuddle's chickens have escaped. Their feathers make Vivienne Volcano very itchy, so Messy has to find a way to scratch her itches and round up the chickens

programme.title: Panic at the Pumpkin Patch
programme.desc: It's pumpkin-picking day at Jackson's farm, but something spooky has been scaring all the pumpkin pickers. Mojo and Bo need to find out what's going on, and chase some ghosts!

programme.title: Pass the Parcel
programme.desc: Lucky's Dad is outraged that modern Pass the Parcel has a present in every layer and changes the rules back to only having one prize in the middle, but Bingo is forever losing.

programme.title: Housework
programme.desc: Mum and Dad vow to only finish their boring housework when the kids stop acting silly, but that's never going to happen, so they end up trying the same approach themselves.

programme.title: The Midnight Badge
programme.desc: Loveable Duggee and the Squirrels return with more educational fun.

programme.title: The Laughter Badge
programme.desc: From sensible chuckles and nervous giggles to Duggee's infectious laughter, once everyone starts, it's so hard to stop. What were they laughing about again? Anyone remember?

programme.title: Stick Time
programme.desc: How many siblings does Norrie have? What's Duggee's favourite badge? What does everyone do on Fridays? Squirrel Club has the answers!

programme.title: Calm Down
programme.desc: Water, water, everywhere - there's a flood in our hospital soap opera! Grown-up Tag the firefighter splashes around. It's a good job grown-up Happy the lifeguard is on hand

programme.title: Go Jet Academy: Irrigation
programme.desc: Uh oh! Glitch accidently uses his size-ray to shrink the Go Jetters and Ubercorn so that they are the size of ants!

programme.title: Bike
programme.desc: Bluey is struggling to learn how to ride her bike. But as she and Dad watch her friends determination with their own tasks, Bluey is inspired to give it another try.

programme.title: Mum School
programme.desc: Bluey plays mum to a brood of bouncy balloons, including an irrepressible floater named Greenie. But she soon discovers that mothering is much harder than she imagined.

programme.title: Ragdoll
programme.desc: Dad agrees to take Bluey and Bingo to the shops to buy an ice-cream if they can get him into the car. Only problem is... he's just entered 'Ragdoll' mode!

programme.title: Fairy Tale
programme.desc: Dad tells Bluey and Bingo a real-life fairy tale about growing up in a wild place called the '80s, about a boy who was cursed when he was mean to his little brother.

programme.title: Andy and the Long Tailed Macaques
programme.desc: Andy, Jen and Scout jet off in the Explorer and head to Thailand on a global adventure in search of long-tailed macaques. The team discover macaques have an appetite for shellfish.

programme.title: Hoop
programme.desc: Bella and Lift visit the Cloud Kitchen, where Patch needs some help from the Playtimers to make hoopy owl bagels. It's time for a tasty adventure!

programme.title: The Ball Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are confused when they see Duggee sitting on a ball because they all have their own favourite way of using it, whether it be kicking, throwing or catching.

programme.title: The Commuting Badge
programme.desc: Norrie is running late to Squirrel Club, so Duggee teaches the squirrels what a commute is - a journey that can take you from home to learn, work or play.

programme.title: The Wisdom Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels see Duggee reading about wise animals and wish to learn more about what it means to be wise.

programme.title: The Blue Mountains, Jamaica
programme.desc: Trouble brews in Jamaica when Glitch's campfire threatens a coffee plantation.

programme.title: Bioluminescent Bay, Puerto Rico
programme.desc: Glitch's bath time puts the creatures of Puerto Rico's Bioluminescent Bay in bubble-trouble.

programme.title: Emily to the Rescue
programme.desc: When a pretend emergency turns into a real emergency, there's only one engine who can come to save the day.

programme.title: Mars As Moon
programme.desc: Mars tries to fill in for a missing Moon, but needs a little coaching from Sarah & Duck.

programme.title: Rainbow Race
programme.desc: The changeable weather means Rainbow has to leave before finishing his story. Sarah & Duck try to find out how the story ends.

programme.title: Wonder Vole
programme.desc: Benjamin can't find his favourite toy, Wonder Vole anywhere. Stanley suggests they retrace his steps but have no luck. Maybe Wonder Vole Pyjamas will help Benjamin feel brave.

programme.title: Treat
programme.desc: Stanley's friends throw him a birthday party. No work for Stan today. Cynthia and Jose take a call from Amare, her tractor is stuck in the mud. Soon, so are all Stanley's vehicles.

programme.title: Once Upon a Pond
programme.desc: Freddie is making a small pond from a washing up bowl in Aunt Fee's garden She asks Freddie to fill it with a bucket, while she gets a surprise for the pond.

programme.title: Mother's Day
programme.desc: Four generations of JoJo's family - JoJo, Mummy, Gran Gran and Great-Gran-Gran - have a relaxing spa day together as they celebrate Mother's Day!

programme.title: Curry Quest
programme.desc: Bingo and Dad must brave a swooping magpie protecting its nest, when they go on a curry swap to Mackenzie's house through the park.

programme.title: Magic
programme.desc: Bluey teaches Bingo how to use magic so she can make Mum play with her, but she forgets to explain the most important rule: never use magic for cheekiness.

programme.title: Chest
programme.desc: Dad tries to teach Bluey how to play chess, but Mum thinks she is still too young. When Bingo joins in, the kids make up their own rules, but they still can't beat Dad.

programme.title: The Dancing Bug Badge

programme.title: I'm Hungry

programme.title: Go Jet Academy: Compass Navigators
programme.desc: Can Kyan and Foz use new compass skills to navigate their way out of an academy maze?

programme.desc: Bingo loves playing with Dad, but sometimes he forgets Bingo is smaller than her sister. Mum teaches Bingo how to use her big girl bark to keep the fun within her limits.

programme.title: The Show
programme.desc: When Bingo drops Mum's breakfast-in-bed on the floor, she's convinced she's ruined her big day. But Bluey helps make amends by putting on a play of how Mum and Dad first met.

programme.title: Turtle Boy
programme.desc: Bingo finds a toy turtle at the playground and wants to take him home, but Dad says it's not the right thing to do.

programme.title: Onesies
programme.desc: When mum's sister Brandy comes over for a visit, she brings the kids onesies as a present, which has an unexpected effect on Bingo.

programme.title: Andy and the Wood Ducks

programme.title: Snail
programme.desc: Bella and Lift visit the Fortress of Fun, where Kingsley and Queenie have a snail slime race. But who will win, Team King or Team Queen?

programme.title: The Size Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels learn about atoms, molecules and cells to help understand sizing when they try to sort a line-up of things from smallest to biggest.

programme.title: The Getting Ready Badge

programme.title: The Cinema Badge

programme.title: The Matterhorn, Italy and Switzerland
programme.desc: Glitch gets into a mountain of trouble as the Go Jetters attempt to climb the Matterhorn.

programme.title: Petra, Jordan

programme.title: Ace's Brave Jump

programme.title: Castle Scribbling

programme.title: Boo Night

programme.title: Carnival

programme.title: Shops

programme.title: It's Time to Find Street Art

programme.title: Pass the Parcel

programme.desc: Barbabravo, Barbalala and Barbabeau are fed up with their brothers and sisters laughing at their expense.

programme.desc: It's a day for practical jokes, but Tim doesn't know when to stop.

programme.title: Tim Rex in Space S1 - Mole
programme.desc: Tim and Dad have to catch a troublesome mole.

programme.title: Tim Rex in Space S2 - Explorer
programme.desc: Tim explores Rumbleton to find somewhere he can have fun alone.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S8 - Ice Cream
programme.desc: Mr Labrador has an ice cream van but runs out of ice cream. Granny Pig suggests Peppa and George make their own ice cream with the help of Mr Labrador.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S8 - Science Museum
programme.desc: Peppa and her friends go on a school trip to visit a science museum. There are lots of fun activities including bubbly water, static balloons and Grampy Rabbit's rocket ship.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S8 - Miss Rabbit's Relaxation Class
programme.desc: Miss Rabbit persuades Mummy Pig to come along to her relaxation class to help her unwind.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S8 - Parking Ticket
programme.desc: When Daddy Pig gets a parking ticket Peppa and George learn that adults have rules just like children.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S2 - The Time Capsule
programme.desc: Peppa and her school friends are making a time capsule. They each put one of their favourite things inside and bury it in the school garden. The children discover that their parents made a time capsule many years ago.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S2 - Recycling
programme.desc: Peppa and George help Mummy Pig tidy up the breakfast things. Mummy Pig tells them that bottles go into a special green box to be recycled. Old newspapers go in a red box and tins go in a blue box. Peppa and George have fun filling the boxes.

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S2 - Buttercup / We Need To Save The Corals
programme.desc: Barbidou's beautiful roses mysteriously disappeared during the night. // Barbapapa decides to tell the barbababies about the time he went to explore the Arctic and the seabed.

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S2 - Bbarbalalalalalala
programme.desc: Barbalala and the family life!

programme.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines S7 - Sparkle's Big Rescue
programme.desc: When Crusher sends Blaze away with one of his latest cheats, Blaze's little sister Sparkle comes to save the day and bring her brother back in time so they can race together to win the Teamwork Trophy!

programme.title: PAW Patrol S11 - Pups Save the Baddies / Pups Save the Yumi Bee
programme.desc: Humdinger, Sid, and Sweetie have joined forces to try and take over the Lookout. // Humdinger sabotages Yumi's Bee costume sending her buzzing out of control.

programme.title: PAW Patrol S3 - A Pup in Sheep's Clothing
programme.desc: When little lambs keep running away from Farmer Al's pasture, it's up to the Paw Patrol to find the missing sheep.

programme.title: Rubble & Crew S3 - The Crew Builds A Firefighter Training Center / The Crew Builds A Sierra Sparkle
programme.desc: When Motor needs help at the fire station, a new Fire Captain comes to town to help train all the pups as new firefighter recruits. // Charger can't wait to help Sierra Sparkle with her big show! Well, until his hurt paw causes a cone complication.

programme.title: Rubble & Crew S3 - The Crew Builds A Giant Duck Plane / The Crew Builds A Vet Room For Motor
programme.desc: A flock of migrating ducks settles in Builder Cove! It's up to Rubble & Crew to help the ducks start moving south. // Motor doesn't want to visit Dr. Diwa at the Vet Clinic... so the pups build a special space just for her!

programme.title: DORA S2 - The Floor Is Guava / We Are The Grumples
programme.desc: Boots wants to enjoy Banana Fest, but the Guava Geyser is erupting! Dora needs to stop the geyser and save the festival. / It's Picture Day, but the Grumpy Old Troll runs away! Dora follows him into Troll World to get him to come out for the picture.

programme.title: DORA S2 - Crabby Wedding / The Cloud Kingdom
programme.desc: Dora's crab friends are getting married but Swiper swipes the ring and loses it in the ocean. Dora has to get the ring back! / Dora and Boots meet Vicky the Vicuna who is missing her magic flute that she needs to go back to the Cloud Kingdom.

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S1 - Clock and Dance / Barbapileup
programme.desc: The barbababies prepare a show for Barbamama's birthday. While Barbalala finishes up, they go to the carnival where Barbabeau gets stuck in an attraction. // Three separate stories telescope into a big final bouquet in the middle of the courtyard.

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S1 - Relay Tales / The Barbababies' World
programme.desc: Barbalib, Barbalala and Barbabelle take turns as narrators to tell a story, each one bringing a very personal touch to it. // The Barbapapa family spends a day at the beach. Divided into 2 teams, the barbababies fight over a sandy peninsula.

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S1 - Greedyguts / Where is Bali?
programme.desc: A goat has escaped from the mountain and is coming to wreak havoc, devouring everything in its path! // Bali is nowhere to be found, and the Barbapapa deploy all their imagination to look for her. They have no idea that a nice surprise awaits them!

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S1 - Barbabright Has a Secret / Super Duper Cool
programme.desc: Barbabright acts strangely. What is he hiding ? The Barbabbabies will do anything to find out. // The Barbapapa decide to save energy. But their efforts are undermined by Barbabright and Barbabelle who build a secret energy-consuming project.

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S1 - Barba TV / The Museum
programme.desc: The barbababies are glued to the TV. Since they love it so much, their parents encourage them to make their own shows. // The Barbapapa visit the museum of evolution. On the program: creation of the Earth, Precambrian submarine and... dinosaurs!

programme.title: Rubble & Crew S3 - The Crew Builds An Art Museum / The Crew Builds A Giant Alphorn
programme.desc: Rubble & Crew build the perfect place to show off River's ever-changing photography projects... Builder Cove's own art museum! // Farmer Zoe has a new goat on her farm! But when she can't find the singing goat, the pups team up with Park Ranger Rose.

programme.title: Rubble & Crew S3 - The Crew Builds A Skyscraper
programme.desc: Rubble & Crew are building their biggest construction project ever... a skyscraper! And a job that huge calls for brand-new, mega-sized construction vehicles! But when Speed Meister sees the pups' big trucks, he calls in help from his big brother.

programme.title: PAW Patrol S7 - Pups Save the Skydivers / Pups Save the Cupcakes
programme.desc: Mayor Goodway and Farmer Al are ready for a day filled with Skydiving fun, but their adventure is quickly derailed. It's Paw Patrol to the rescue! // Alex and the Mini Patrol get locked inside the flounder, the Paw Patrol dives in to save the day!

programme.title: PAW Patrol S7 - Pups Save A Lost Gold Miner / Pups Save Uncle Otis From His Cabin
programme.desc: Uncle Otis takes a trip to a lost gold mine. After wandering off course, Ryder and the Pups must save him from the booby-trapped mine. // Uncle Otis's installs a Smart Home 3000, in his cabin, that ends up trapping Uncle Otis and Mr. Wingnut inside!

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S2 - The Mountain Eater / The First Day Of School
programme.desc: Barbapapa tells the Barbababies about his extraordinary encounter with a wolf. // Tomorrow is the Barbababies' first day of school.

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S1 - The Barbapapa Tree / The Barbababies' birthday
programme.desc: Barbapapa and Barbamama return to the tree they were born under. It's in bad condition. They must rescue it quickly without disturbing the nearby animals. // It's the Barbababies's birthday. They all want to do something different with Barbapapa!

programme.title: Tim Rex in Space S1 - Rocket Race
programme.desc: Tommy is in a Rocket Race, Tim supports his brother.

programme.title: Tim Rex in Space S1 - Magic
programme.desc: Tim distracts Tia when Tusky is in the washing machine.

programme.title: Tim Rex in Space S1 - Parents
programme.desc: The kids become the parents and the parents become the kids.

programme.title: Rubble & Crew S2 - The Crew Builds A Rooftop Stage / The Crew Fixes The Lighthouse
programme.desc: When Grocer Gabriel and Sierra Sparkle both need construction help before Banana Day, Rubble & Crew has their paws full. // Speed Meister shines his face in the sky with the lighthouse! But when a ship needs that light, the pups jump into action.

programme.title: Rubble & Crew S2 - The Crew Builds A Solar-Powered Bus / The Crew Builds A Lifeguard Tower
programme.desc: When Speed Meister steals Rubble & Crew's bus, the pups have to stop it in time for Sierra Sparkle's big concert! // It's the perfect beach day in Builder Cove! If Rubble & Crew can build a lifeguard tower so the beach can open...

programme.title: DORA S4 - Mascota Mobile / Kite Festival
programme.desc: Dora is about to give her pets a bath when the pet-washing truck goes haywire, and she has to save pets throughout the rainforest! // Dora and Boots save a mouse in time for him to show off his giant kite at the Rainforest Kite Festival.

programme.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines S9 - Sea Turtle Submarine
programme.desc: Blaze and AJ are at the beach when they meet an adorable new friend: Shelly the sea turtle! But when Shelly can't find her way home to the Seaweed Forest, Blaze turns into a Sea Turtle Submarine to help lead the way!

programme.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines S7 - Knights in Sparkling Armor
programme.desc: When Crusher and Pickle are trapped inside a cage over a bubbling slime swap, it's up to Blaze, AJ, and Sparkle to become...Knights! Will they be able to rescue Crusher and Pickle from the swamp before it's too late?

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S1 - The Cave Barbapapas / The Little Monsters
programme.desc: The barbababies discover a strange cave. Barbalib tells the story of the caves Barbapapa and how they transformed. // The Barbababies have a sleepover in the living room. Fearing the monsters in the closet, they set up wacky traps to catch them.

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S1 - The Perfect Dinner / The Kittens
programme.desc: Barbapapa and Barbamama go out to celebrate their birthdays. Barbabelle is in charge and gets overwhelmed. // Barbabelle watches Bali's kittens. She's scared something will happen and won't let them out. Barbamama must intervene to help the kittens.

programme.title: Tim Rex in Space S1 - Rocket Race / Magic / Parents
programme.desc: Tommy is in a Rocket Race, Tim supports his brother. // Tim distracts Tia when Tusky is in the washing machine. // The kids become the parents and the parents become the kids.

programme.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines S7 - The Robot Championship
programme.desc: It's the Robot Championship - and only the fastest, strongest, smartest robot will win! Using coding, can Blaze win enough sports to take home the Robot Championship trophy?

programme.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines S7 - Super Smash Race
programme.desc: Get ready to crash and bash, 'cause today is the SUPER SMASH RACE! But when Crusher cheats and sends Zeg and Blaze far away, it's up to Blaze to help Zeg get back to the race, so he can slam and wham his way to a SMASH-tacular finish!

programme.title: Rubble & Crew S2 - The Crew Builds A Reuse-It Station / The Crew Builds A Duck Bridge
programme.desc: When Speed Meister builds his own station for reusing trash, the pups have to clean up the mess all over Builder Cove. // After a baby duckling follows them home, Rubble & Crew use their construction know-how to bring the duckling back to its home.

programme.title: Rubble & Crew S2 - The Crew Builds A Pizza Parlor / The Crew Builds An Airport Road
programme.desc: Mayor Greatway needs a lot of pizzas, fast! But when Speed Meister steps in, the pups have to fix his pizza problem. // When a family can't get to the airport in time on Speed Meister's road, Rubble & Crew has to build a new road before takeoff.

programme.title: PAW Patrol S1 - Pups Save the Circus / Pup a Doodle Do
programme.desc: Ryder gets a call from the Circus ringmaster - Ellie the baby elephant has escaped from the circus train! // Mayor Goodway's purse chicken "Chickaletta" has gone missing. Ryder and the Paw Patrol search Adventure bay.

programme.title: PAW Patrol S1 - Pups Pit Crew / Pups Fight Fire
programme.desc: Ryder and the PAW Patrol have to rescue Alex when he takes off on his new "super trike". // Marshall proves he is a true hero when he stops to put out a real fire on the beach during a race against the clock for a trophy.

programme.desc: Dora and Boots run into Swiper and his nephew Zorrito! They must make it home before Swiper and Zorrito can swipe their teddy bear. // Dora meets Boots' cousin, Sombrera, and they journey across the rainforest to find the special blue bananas!

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Musical Statues

programme.desc: Bluey teaches Bingo how to use magic so she can make Mum play with her, but she forgets to explain the most important rule: never use magic for cheekiness.

programme.desc: Dad tries to teach Bluey how to play chess, but Mum thinks she is still too young. When Bingo joins in, the kids make up their own rules, but they still can't beat Dad.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Sheep Dog

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Pizza Badge

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S3) - Donkey Jump
programme.desc: Sarah & Duck try to help Donkey get his jumping confidence back by building a surprise for him in their back garden.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S3) - Perimeter Pals
programme.desc: Sarah, Duck & Bug set off on a big adventure, through uncharted territory, as they attempt to cycle all the way around the park.

programme.title: Stan Can (S1) - Band
programme.desc: Fifi, Little Woo and Fred call up Stanley to ask him to film their new song. They go around the town trying to find the perfect place.

programme.title: Stan Can (S1) - Wonder Vole
programme.desc: Benjamin can't find his favourite toy, Wonder Vole anywhere. Stanley suggests they retrace his steps but have no luck. Maybe Wonder Vole Pyjamas will help Benjamin feel brave.

programme.title: Number 1 Newton Avenue (S1) - Toy Champion
programme.desc: Libby and her favourite toys 'Giggles' and 'Big Octopus' are throwing balls into buckets. Libby tips the buckets out onto her bed and counts the balls to see who is the winner, but they all end up mixed together.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran (S3) - It's Time To Look For Frogs
programme.desc: At the wetland centre, JoJo and her friends Alfie, Raya, Jaxon and Isaiah find frog spawn. Gran Gran and Cynthia teach them about the life cycle of frog spawn to tadpole and frog.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Magic
programme.desc: Bluey teaches Bingo how to use magic so she can make Mum play with her, but she forgets to explain the most important rule: never use magic for cheekiness.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Chest
programme.desc: Dad tries to teach Bluey how to play chess, but Mum thinks she is still too young. When Bingo joins in, the kids make up their own rules, but they still can't beat Dad.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Sheep Dog
programme.desc: Dad agrees to play Sheepdog with Bluey and Bingo to stop them from disturbing Mum who is taking a well-earned rest, but looking after a sheep is harder work than they expected.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Pizza Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels help Duggee try out his new outdoor pizza oven. Duggee makes the bases, then the Squirrels each put on all the toppings they like best. Some of their combinations are... interesting!

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Train Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is playing with his train set. Choo-choo! It's amazing! The squirrels are curious and want to know all about it.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Potato Time
programme.desc: At Squirrel Club, Duggee forgets how to woof, Duggly comes to visit, Roly celebrates Potato Time, and Billy teaches everyone the Bugatron dance!

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Wolong Panda Reserve, China
programme.desc: The Go Jetters visit a nature reserve in China. But who's taking all the pandas' bamboo?

programme.title: Roots & Fruits (S1) - Grapes
programme.desc: Live from the Roots & Fruits Theatre, it's the spectacular acrobatic grapes working together to perform the most difficult structures to perfection.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits (S1) - Potato
programme.desc: Live from the Roots & Fruits theatre, it's Potato dedicating a song to his uncle Spud, who went on a spaceship to the moon.

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - Double Doughnut Rescue
programme.desc: Evil Pea plunges Broccoli and Carrot into the doughnut toppings simultaneously and Supertato almost quits being a Superhero when he can't save his two friends at the same time.

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - Evil Pea Takes a Break
programme.desc: The Cobs try to capture Supertato while Evil Pea is on holiday, but it goes wrong, resulting in Evil Pea getting covered in flour and custard over in the Bath Product's Aisle.

programme.title: Teletubbies (S1) - Stairs
programme.desc: A musical staircase magically appears in Teletubbyland. Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po take turns making music as they go up and down the stairs.

programme.title: Yakka Dee (S2) - Cat
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say 'cat' and we go on a whirlwind word adventure! There's a black cat, a white cat, a kitten cat and a purring cat, as well as a very cool cat!

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO (S3) - Down the Drain
programme.desc: Messy borrows Zoe's umbrella, and it gets swept away by the rain. Messy and his friends go on a white-water adventure down the drain in search for it.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops (S1) - Wingsuit Yourself
programme.desc: Tao needs help learning to fly his new wingsuit for a big town event, and Mojo and Bo are the experts. Can they help him find his inner bird before it's too late?

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Explorers
programme.desc: While waiting to be picked up from school, Jack plays at being a sailor trying to find his way back home to Australia. Meanwhile, Jack's Dad has got lost on route to collect him.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Perfect
programme.desc: For her Father's Day card, Bluey sets out to draw a picture of herself and her father together. While recalling her favourite memories of playing with Bandit, Bluey struggles with the idea that her drawing must be perfect. Chilli tries to convince Bluey that perfection isn't easy, or absolutely necessary.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S5) - The Face Painting Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are looking for Duggee but can't find him. Instead, they find someone who looks like Enid, only much too big. Duggee has painted his face to look like Enid!

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S5) - The Carrot Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are admiring Duggee's crop of giant carrots when they hear a noise. They find the Rabbits busy preparing for the Carrot Solstice.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Master of Puppets
programme.desc: At Squirrel Club, there's a story told in blocks, the tale of a first tooth, a fable about changing emotions, and a yarn involving the Squirrels as puppets.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Cool, Man
programme.desc: At Squirrel Club, Detective Puppy solves the mystery of a missing biscuit, the Rabbits tell us what's cool, and the Squirrels help Delivery Chipmunk with a huge parcel.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Whistler Mountain, Canada
programme.desc: The Go Jetters are on Whistler Mountain in Canada doing some skiing and checking out the amazing cable car which runs high up between the mountains.

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Spy Game
programme.desc: When Bingo stops playing Bluey's spy game, their grown-up controlling device stops working properly! Bluey now sees how important Bingo is and needs to win her back!

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - Army

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Musical Statues

programme.title: 非誠勿擾(2017) / Perfect Match (2017)
programme.desc: 《非誠勿擾》全新改版，24位女嘉賓分為心動區和觀察區，男嘉賓暫不亮相，在「第二現場」與女嘉賓隔空對話。男女嘉賓通過雙向選擇，決定兩人能否成功牽手。.

programme.title: 偏愛之戀 / Love Wins All
programme.desc: 22位單身男女為愛而來，隻身抵達遠離都市的荒野之境，展開為期14天的偏愛之戀旅程；當生存競技撞上戀愛修羅場，淘汰危機和情感抉擇之下，一場麫包與玫瑰的較量即將展開，他們能否找到屬於自己的愛與偏愛？.

programme.title: 老板不知道的我：老友季 / Talk To Your Boss: Friends Season
programme.desc: 節目全新升級，以「老友季」作為主題，把觀察樣本聚焦在情感更濃、羈絆更深的職場戰友身上，對職場上下級關系的維度進行了深度開拓；通過職場老友這一切面，去探討職場中更復雜的問題解法。.

programme.title: 我們的歌 第五季 / Singing With Legends Season 5 (Repackaged)
programme.desc: 在音樂主題上再度突破，以「一路為伍，向生綻放」為主題，甄選了貼近生活的歌曲和作品，用歌聲傳遞正能量；邀請了A-Lin、大張偉、庾澄慶、馬嘉祺、光良、蘇慧玲、任賢齊、陳卓璇、曾比特、白舉綱、吳莫愁等老、中、青三代歌手，在全新升級的「盲選配對」模式中組合獻唱，在代際傳承、時代交融中突破自我，打造一場最溫暖、最動人的音樂盛宴。.

programme.title: 非誠勿擾(2021) (S12) / Perfect Match (2021)
programme.desc: 《非誠勿擾》回歸經典規則。男嘉賓登場後，將通過「愛之請回答」「愛之再判斷」「愛之終決選」三個環節與24位女嘉賓互相了解，還有根據大數據匹配的「智推女生」參與最終決選。陳銘、黃瀾加盟「非誠合夥人」，以全新視角解讀愛情。.

programme.title: 極限挑戰 第九季 / Go Fighting! Season 9 (Repackaged)
programme.desc: 在全新的征程上，由黃曉明、大張偉、龔俊、黃明昊、嚴浩翔、黃景瑜、賈乃亮、岳雲鵬組成「極挑團」；圍繞當下社會熱點，展開一場開放式的戶外項目及任務；一起領略自然，解鎖更多挑戰。.

programme.title: 非誠勿擾(2017) / Perfect Match (2017)
programme.desc: 《非誠勿擾》全新改版，24位女嘉賓分為心動區和觀察區，男嘉賓暫不亮相，在「第二現場」與女嘉賓隔空對話。男女嘉賓通過雙向選擇，決定兩人能否成功牽手。.

programme.title: 了不起! 舞社 第二季 / Great Dance Crew Season 2 (Repackaged)
programme.desc: 聚焦「齊舞」體裁，除了“元老”贊多、程瀟回歸，還邀請了楊丞琳、鄭秀妍、高瀚宇、李斯丹妮加盟主理人與原生廠牌組成6支全新的明星限定組合，共同創作不同風格的齊舞作品，通過數輪競技和淘汰，聯合征戰為尊嚴battle到底，爭奪最終的「年度最佳廠牌」榮譽。.

programme.title: 海昏行 第1季 (短劇) / Voyage to Haihun Season 1 (Mini drama)
programme.desc: 講述現代失意青年王衡意外穿越到西漢，結識了神似前女友的俠女得九，並與性格開朗的王爺劉賀成為摯友；他們試圖憑藉王衡的現代思維與知識，聯手改變劉賀悲劇性的命運，並在過程中共同成長、療愈彼此。.

programme.title: 雙刃 (短劇) / Higher (Mini drama)
programme.desc: 以近未來科幻安全危機為背景，講述了來自狂風特勤學院的曾經師徒二人姜振和白帆，在紫晶集團中邊敵對邊掩護彼此身份，姜振為意外車禍逝去的妹妹查明真相，並與白帆一同破解控制殘疾人大腦的暗黑科技公司，幫弱者脫離險境討回公道的故事。.

programme.title: 開始跳舞吧 第2季 / Ready To Dance Season 2
programme.desc: 第2季邀請了來自粵港澳地區的街舞少年團參加，並由贊多、敖子逸、王晨藝、黃譽博等擔任街舞領軍人物，少年們在他們的帶領下，分別進行初舞台、合作舞台以及最終的留名舞台三個階段的挑戰，通過動感的音樂和充滿激情的舞蹈，將中國傳統文化特色與街舞文化相結合。.

programme.title: 有秘密的我們 第2季 / Secrets in Love Season 2
programme.desc: 以山野為背景，10位素人嘉賓都攜帶一個秘密進入「真相小屋」，這些秘密可能涉及過去的傷痛、未了的心願等，隨著節目推進逐漸揭曉；秘密成為推動他們情感發展的關鍵因素，也增加了未知性和驚喜感，並放棄了傳統戀綜依賴觀察室嘉賓或專家解析的模式，讓觀眾直接充當觀察者。.

programme.title: 非誠勿擾(2021) (S12) / Perfect Match (2021)
programme.desc: 《非誠勿擾》回歸經典規則。男嘉賓登場後，將通過「愛之請回答」「愛之再判斷」「愛之終決選」三個環節與24位女嘉賓互相了解，還有根據大數據匹配的「智推女生」參與最終決選。陳銘、黃瀾加盟「非誠合夥人」，以全新視角解讀愛情。.

programme.title: 來吧兄弟 / Come on, Brothers!
programme.desc: 由陳小春、潘瑋柏、包貝爾、孫堅、段博文、謝彬彬六位不同類型的男藝人組成「來吧兄弟團」，完成各種任務挑戰。.

programme.title: 全力以赴的行動派 第二季 / City All In Tribe Season 2
